title: On Agentic Manipulation Policies
abstract: arXiv:2611.09892v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Recent work on robot manipulation has focused on specialist policies trained on demonstrations. We show that generalist AI models can control manipulators more reliably than specialist policies such as vision-language-action models (VLAs) and world-action models (WAMs). We systematically analyze agentic manipulation policies (AMPs), in which a generalist AI model commands the manipulator directly, adapting its actions as the task unfolds. We present AMP1, a reference harness that runs unchanged across single-arm, bimanual, and mobile manipulation. AMP1 achieves state-of-the-art results on the RoboLab-120 and CaP-Gym benchmarks, with no demonstrations or task-specific training. On RoboLab-120, AMP1 reaches an 85.6% success rate zero-shot, compared to 49.2% and 42.9% for leading VLA and WAM policies. The agent succeeds zero-shot in 104 of 108 real-world trials spanning twelve tasks and three robot instances, reducing failure rate

translated_abstract: 近年来机器人操作领域的研究主要聚焦于通过演示数据训练的专用策略。我们证明，通用型AI模型能够比专用策略（如视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）和世界-动作模型（WAM））更可靠地控制机械臂。我们系统地分析了智能体式操作策略（AMP），即由通用型AI模型直接指挥机械臂，并随着任务的展开自适应地调整其动作。我们提出了AMP1，一个可在单臂、双臂和移动操作中无需任何改动即可运行的参考框架。AMP1在RoboLab-120和CaP-Gym基准测试中取得了最先进的结果，且无需任何演示数据或任务特定训练。在RoboLab-120上，AMP1零样本成功率达到85.6%，而领先的VLA和WAM策略分别仅为49.2%和42.9%。该智能体在涵盖十二个任务和三台机器人的108次真实世界测试中零样本成功了104次，显著降低了失败率。
tldr: 提出AMP1智能体式操作框架，证明通用AI模型直接控制机械臂可零样本超越VLA和WAM等专用策略，在RoboLab-120上达到85.6%的成功率。
en_tdlr: AMP1 shows that generalist AI models directly commanding robot manipulators outperform specialist VLA and WAM policies zero-shot, achieving an 85.6% success rate on RoboLab-120.
